additional_concerns: Definition preservation does not validate the complete relief rule. Nodes 1bf6918f69c6b37738daeb83, 4e6a162c35678e9ddf17ad8e, ce439b1cf9ed8301fbb68f94 and ea4d19630f8cab09065b1909 convert preservation of existing application processing into a relief exclusion. The circular does not expressly establish that inference; preservation of procedure without substantive disqualification remains unresolved.

The explicit 28 November 2025 commencement provision must be read alongside the introductory immediate-effect language. Neither establishes a universal assessment-event or implementation-date test. Subsequent approval, withdrawal and resubmission treatment is not supplied.

The relevant SFC FAQs, including the revamped FAQ on SFC Authorization of UCITS Funds, and clarification of legacy application treatment are missing. The two supplied unbound dependency IDs lack identifying metadata and cannot reliably be assigned to these authorities. These missing materials do not undermine the express definitional claims assessed here.

Applicable home-jurisdiction rules and evidence supporting novelty, complexity and possible local policy implications are needed for an actual application. The formulas accept these classifications as inputs rather than establish them. Item (ii) does not expressly add a separate home-supervision condition.

Node 4d548f2e09bc36ef51212f64 excludes legacy cases from its question; node b66b3e831bb98a12db59dffa assesses substantive conditions independently of procedure. Neither settles actual relief for a preserved application. Node 8eb374ffa546ddd2ba291e37 retains that unresolved question without an executable formalization.
